## Design

### 2026-10-13 – October 12:

**1h**

October 12:
Learned how to sketch

I started by reading the guide all the way through to get a feel for things. Then I started using the guide to make my first sketch. I made a square and turned it into a platform, then I made a line and used it to make a plate. I also learned the basics of a sweep tool.

![IMG_7464](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/9ab547ad4e80ad7566af92bfe2ee838c0722b60c0521aa321265a0bd2b6225ad.jpg)

I also learned how to delete a part

![IMG_7470](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/4f068c09c0bebed72e430068b42530f4977531273c742b305d995db356ad0c02.jpg)

### 2026-10-13 – October 13

**2.5h**

October 13
I messed up

Today I began by attempting to make 2 conjoined curves. When beginning the plane I realized I had accidentally deleted the line from yesterday too, so I made a line on the front plane and tried to build on that. Eventually this would lead to me building everything on the wrong plane.

Today I used a line to make a slanted plane at an angle. I then make a second perpendicular line and used the two to make a curve. I tried using the fillet but it just wouldn’t work no matter what.

![IMG_7465](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/d60bd513705a3b2b63adb5c7dae6c14e49b4a80147253364b5361ecf3639dabe.jpg)
So then I decided to use the line and angle method, but this was also unsuccessful because I couldn't align the line and circle right.

![IMG_7466](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/c17caed87e7f96271d6c5bb9b921c046209f57c17800bf0425d411f34d65b7c1.jpg)
Finally after playing around for a while I figured out a method that worked. It used a few extra lines and the mirror tool but was easier to work with, and in the end I made a nice design.

![IMG_7467](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/c063cc20ea50d114a0ca6d985ee6e5f63d37bebaa10bab1eb4ae4ab069c2c997.jpg)

Then I turned it all into one single curve.

![IMG_7468](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/4fdacd867d6628e368151c7bcc21ccdaebd09db5e374fb6fe8b784f927289a72.jpg)

After this I tried using the sweep tool when I realized the mistake I had made in the beginning (wrong plane)

![IMG_7469](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/8849de84b9e42a523544b9340fae0091e91a28c2b61f1e56c9aac6948204f904.jpg)

So next session I will work on fixing that.

### 2026-10-14 – October 14:

**2.3h**

FIXED IT

### 2026-10-16 – October 16: Base design done!

**3.2h**

October 16: Base design done!

Today I began by trying to move my parts around to try and connect them together. But it was too confusing so I started building a spiral part.

![IMG_7492](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/041bb481d04e93f9b06ecc843d8151ee244c99c0738509c358ab53b956583b2f.jpg)

At first there were a lot of problems and nothing worked.

![IMG_7493](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/50cb614bba42d49858979291aa15284c1d8f243ff5e75ec08ade5fc39119324c.jpg)

Eventually I realized the best way to build this was by sketching a start, making a helix, and putting them together.

![IMG_7494](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/696ba42246061b184c1944e204539e45cab8cf8002c31b51287475a499a2dfd3.jpg)

I ended up with this spiral

Now I needed to connect all these parts, so I watched a few videos and learned the different options.
My favorite choice ended up being the one where I made a new part and used it as a barrier to keep the marble from falling out and, at the same time, connecting the spiral and funnel.

![IMG_7495](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/c3132c1a766341f0722e8ebf661c06d2a5b5f7cd1471b5b561a0311734c66942.jpg)

![IMG_7496](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/ce0baa741d00f933619d2f284725d1a2c45006eebf2857e8d37a459953fd38a6.jpg)

![IMG_7497](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/e9cd5ce5be12a227352aed9596a750529d3202a2e9a0589656963ed63fc9c5c1.jpg)

Then I tried connecting the last part to the spiral in a similar way, but it didn’t look right and I just didn’t like the part in general.
So I deleted the last part and in its place built a box to catch the marble.
The box is circular and built on a square base because it looked fancy.

![IMG_7498](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/d11783b5830872807a1be5b3e85b2656e7f844ea18909637b6992e2e2ffc4149.jpg)

Total time: 3.2 hours

I still have it so the spiral is sort of resting on the edge of the box so I want to add supports and maybe another part somewhere to make the design more complex.

### 2026-10-17 – October 17:

**2.7h**

October 17:
Adding more parts

Today I began by adding a rod to use as a support for the build, but I realized the rod could not connect to the base. So I added a second base underneath the first base Id built. Then I added a rod that would reach the funnel and support the highest point of the build.

![IMG_7501](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/a539014b639e7b6ff06a538e066f4ebbf467de9dd9f482593df381798b0158a9.jpg)

After this I began working on another part for the marble run. Using the guide I designed a sketch for a plinko board. This was pretty challenging since I had to use a lot of geometry and kept messing up my calculations and needing to redo the design.

![IMG_7502](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/bf79933f2a98a5dffb23a2cc990953e96d1b875414a8486fc1c55c977d4f4d68.jpg)

I ended up making my board slightly smaller than the one in the guide by deleting 2 of the bottom rows, this was because I wanted my design to be a single route and not too tall.

![IMG_7503](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/b9bc4ab23e607a76d06a3d5ee9a216eaaf19df5e0e023228e5985522e018b377.jpg)

I ended up with a working sketch with the shape I wanted. I then extruded the entire sketch to 3mm and the walls/rods to 16mm as the guide instructed.
But when I went to connect everything I realized I built the plinko board on the wrong plane which is a problem. The board lays flat now when I wanted it to be vertical so the marble would go through it before falling into the funnel.

![IMG_7504](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/4O0MF6adIuVt3iBRHlfg0QffpYarYimf/eca8f0b3e29d679127d7cb7adfdf90bca95db5baf810eeffdee192c0bb50a0a1.jpg)

To fix this I will have to go back to the sketch and assign it a different plane.

Total time: 2.7 hours
